HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW: This is a very competitive opener to the 10-race card, making it hard to narrow it down to just four horses. SPORTS WRACK (4) is an experienced performer who is racing better than his numerical form suggests. He’s had some really tough races recently and has still been performing well. If he maps better here, he finds a race to get back into the winner’s circle. THE BLAZINBOOTS (3) has been quite impressive at his last three starts, finishing second on each occasion. In one of those runs, he flashed home very well from the back of the field, while in the other two he raced in the breeze. All three starts were from barrier five, and he’s versatile enough to handle different scenarios. He gets a better barrier here. ARTIST (6) has been racing well and has the best sectional times in this event, but the barrier is sticky. IM THE REASON (1) is second-up and should improve from his first-up third at this track. The barrier is suitable. SELECTIONS:SPORTS WRACK (4), THE BLAZINBOOTS (3), ARTIST (6), IM THE REASON (1)

OVERVIEW:KIMCHI (4) has found the front and been narrowly beaten into second at his last two starts. He is racing well, and with the scratching of YANKEE RAIN (2), he is more likely to map positively here. REGAL ROCK (6) was very impressive last start. He raced tough, applying pressure in the breeze before racing clear to win by more than 10 metres. He can make his own luck. WINGATE GUY (10) has been great at his last two starts, using his good speed to flash home strongly for a win and a second. He seems to be racing back to his best, but the tricky barrier is a concern over the short trip. From the barrier, MALANI JOH (1) looks to map well and can’t be left out of the exotics. SELECTIONS:KIMCHI (4), REGAL ROCK (6), WINGATE GUY (10), MALANI JOH (1)

OVERVIEW: NIGHT FLIGHT (6) is third-up here. First-up, he was held up but ran home well into fourth at Melton behind Majaro Girl. Last start, he was OK but didn’t have the high speed to make up ground late. He does have good gate speed and could map well here. He should improve with fitness. AFRICAN GALA (9) is a nice horse when he gets things right. Two starts ago, he hit the line brilliantly to finish second, but last start he got it wrong with his manners. He needs to trot throughout here. MISS MUSCLE (11) ran a very brave fourth in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series 2yo Trotting Fillies Final two starts ago. She got it wrong with her manners last start. She is an exciting prospect for the future, but she is only a two-year-old taking on the older horses here and will need to overcome a wide back-row barrier. AI SEDHAI (5) has good sectional times and is a good value first-four chance here if he gets some luck. Also respecting LIFE ON THE HILL (7) who was a winner last start but has a sticky barrier here. SELECTIONS:NIGHT FLIGHT (6), AFRICAN GALA (9), MISS MUSCLE (11) AI SEDHAI (5).

OVERVIEW: This is a nice event with plenty of progressive performers. ALECTRONA (5) is a lightly raced trotter who is putting it all together nicely and has strung some strong performances together recently. She was a clear third last start behind the smart No Money No Honey in the Vicbred Super Series Silver. She’s getting better with each run and finds a suitable race here. TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (7) has been impressive with some nice performances in her recent Vicbred Super Series starts, including a solid fourth in the Group 1 Final last start. She is a high-speed trotter who can be competitive with the right run. PURPLE MOON (10) was outstanding last start. She galloped out of contention, caught the field and still managed to storm home into second. She faces a tough barrier here, but she’s racing well. JILLIBY RADIANCE (6) is a smart filly who is still figuring out what racing is all about. She raced well last start but got too keen when leading and still battled on well. With some luck and better manners, she’s a winning chance. I also have a lot of respect for CALLINAN (2), who is a tough horse and should map well here. BACK: ALECTRONA (5)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALECTRONA (5), TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (7), PURPLE MOON (10), JILLIBY RADIANCE (6).

OVERVIEW: GLENLINE (9) has a great turn of foot and is a brilliant sit sprinter. From the barrier, he looks set to get the perfect trip to storm home late. BLUE OCEAN (1) has been racing OK if we forgive his last start, when he had broken gear. He gets a good barrier to secure a fence-line trip here. BELVU BANDIT (8) has been racing well recently without much luck. If he can find the gaps here, he can capitalise. ICANMOTOR (5) was held up last start but let down nicely once he found clear running. He’s a nice chance here if he gets the right trip. Also respecting ATOMIC GLORY (2) here. BACK: GLENLINE (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:GLENLINE (9), BLUE OCEAN (1), BELVU BANDIT (8), ICANMOTOR (5)

OVERVIEW: SNICKERS EXPRESS (9) is a nice trotter who has been ultra-consistent recently. He flashed home nicely into third last start. Barrier nine should allow him to settle and be saved for one run. LOUIEVILLE LASS (4) did it tough in the breeze last start, tiring a little late. Her start prior was a nice third at Geelong. She is a 10-time winner and has the experience to be competitive here. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (5) is third-up here and should be near peak fitness. Her first-up second was good, and last start she finished sixth after a tough run but still hit the line well. NEDZA THRILLER (6) was a solid second last start at Charlton when he was able to find the fence from the stand start. He returns to mobile conditions here, and the barrier looks awkward for him. BACK: SNICKERS EXPRESS (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SNICKERS EXPRESS (9), LOUIEVILLE LASS (4), CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (5), NEDZA THRILLER (6)

OVERVIEW: NATHANS DREAMER (1) is having her third career start here, but she has had plenty of trials to gain experience. Last start, she got well back at Cranbourne but hit the line well for third. She should get a good fence trip here if she stays trotting. KYVALLEY JOYRIDE (7) is a very well-bred gelding having his third start this preparation. He has the best sectional times on exposed form in this race. He is racing well and still looks to be developing his point-to-point speed late in his races. INTHE NORTY CORNER(2) is a first starter here for Kyle Marshall. She was well beaten in a recent trial at Geelong, so we will learn more about her here. BILLYSOPHIA (6) will need some luck from the barrier but finds a suitable race here. BACK: NATHANS DREAMER (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:NATHANS DREAMER (1), KYVALLEY JOYRIDE (7), INTHE NORTY CORNER(2), BILLYSOPHIA (6)

OVERVIEW: SNOWIN (8) is an Andy Gath-trained runner who was third on debut last start after leading at Melton. She’s bred to be a nice horse, sired by Bold Eagle out of Aldebaran Shakira. Barrier eight is a little awkward, but she should improve from her first start with race experience. ASONGOFTHEHEART (9) is a first starter here for Katrina Fitzpatrick. She let down nicely in a recent Ballarat trial. We will learn more about her here, but she appears to have some promise. LEZAMA (6) has been racing well and consistently recently. With the right run, she’s a threat here. ALCOMBZ (3) is first-up here and only having his fifth career start. In his first preparation, he was slow to begin in his races. He should improve with experience, and Courtney Slater’s team are flying. Two other horses to note in this event are first starter GULBAHAR (7) and HENRYS HORSE (1), who is first-up for John Douglas and trialled well. BACK: SNOWIN (8)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ASONGOFTHEHEART (9), SNOWIN (8), LEZAMA (6), ALCOMBZ (3)

OVERVIEW: DREAMS FOREVER (1) had a wide and unlucky run last start in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final won by Kahula. She is a smart individual who’s perhaps been overshadowed by her superstar stablemate Ideal Frankie. However, she’s a talented filly in her own right and gets the ideal barrier here to show her class and break through for her maiden victory. BELLA LOUISE (5) is a tough mare first-up in the care of John Justice. From the awkward barrier, she may have to make her own luck, but she has the ability to be competitive. BRAVE ART (6) is first-up here for new trainer Carson Millar, who has a good record with new horses in his team. She does have a tricky barrier to overcome. MIDNIGHT MOJO (2) is a good sit sprinter and, with the right run, will be flashing home late. SELECTIONS:DREAMS FOREVER (1), BELLA LOUISE (5), BRAVE ART (6), MIDNIGHT MOJO (2)

OVERVIEW: HOUSE PARTY (6) had two brilliant wins in 2025 before going to the sidelines, returning recently in the Vicbred Super Series. She was good, but it was always going to be a challenging ask fresh off such a long break. She finds a suitable race here to build her confidence and is likely to be quite short in the market. KING BALDWIN (4) has had only two career starts. He was eye-catching when winning on debut at Cranbourne, flashing home strongly, before finishing seventh last start in a race won by the talented Zanda Man. He looks like a progressive type, but it will be hard to beat HOUSE PARTY (6) here. EXOTIC CHESTER (2) ran home nicely into fourth at Melton last start. That was in July, and he is first-up here after a winning trial at Geelong. RYTA (3) is second-up here for John Douglas. He was good when leading first-up, only to be run down late by some swoopers. He should improve with fitness, as that first-up performance was his first start since October last year. SELECTIONS:HOUSE PARTY (6), KING BALDWIN (4), EXOTIC CHESTER (2), RYTA (3) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: OZZIE DIAMOND (3) is a maiden taking on more experienced horses who have already won races, but she has been racing better than her numerical form suggests. She finished fifth in the Vicbred Super Series heat two starts ago behind Ideal Frankie before being a late scratching from the semi-final. She raced well last start at Mildura but was checked late. She has the best sectional times in this event. BLUE CANNON (1) ran home well last start at this track despite racing wide. He should get a much better trip from the fence here and, being third-up, should be close to peak fitness. IAMAWINGATE (8) is racing well and, with the right trip, has the turn of foot to flash home late. TREACHEROUSTIMES (5) has the gate speed and turn of foot to put himself in a competitive position early. BACK: OZZIE DIAMOND (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:OZZIE DIAMOND (3), BLUE CANNON (1), IAMAWINGATE (8), TREACHEROUSTIMES (5)

OVERVIEW: SHEER ME (4) is second-up here for new trainer Alex Ashwood. She ran well at Melton last start in good time, leading and only being beaten narrowly late. She should take improvement from that performance. MYSTIC MOTIVER (2) is a lightly raced mare having just her fifth career start. She is first-up here, but she performed well last campaign and should continue to improve with experience. She will likely map well here. SPOT THE DEVIL (9) is third up here for new trainer Mark Watson. He is racing ok and gets a good barrier to map well here.DYGANALI (6) got well back last start but ran home OK. She is racing well and looks close to breaking through for her maiden victory. ZEE HOUTEN (5) is having her second career start but hasn’t raced since September 2024. Her recent trial form has been good, but race fitness could be a query from the barrier here. BACK: SHEER ME (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:SHEER ME (4), MYSTIC MOTIVER (2), SPOT THE DEVIL (9),DYGANALI (6)

OVERVIEW: SOHO PLAYGIRL (7) flashed home to win impressively by a nice margin two starts ago at Shepparton. Last start, she was held up late but let down well once she found clear running. Barrier seven makes it challenging, but she has the class to overcome it. THE NIGHT FOX (4) is second-up here after arriving from New Zealand. In his first-up run, he got stuck in the breeze and raced keenly before tiring late. He’s been back to the trials since, where he has been OK, and he should improve with that run under his belt. POPCORNFRIDAY (8) is first-up here but has options being the only horse on the second row. His last few runs before going for a spell were strong, and he should get his chance to settle early. OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (5) is stepping out for start 214. He’s an experienced horse with a great turn of foot. He’s racing well but has an awkward barrier to overcome. SELECTIONS: SOHO PLAYGIRL (7), THE NIGHT FOX (4), POPCORNFRIDAY (8), OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (5)

OVERVIEW: MELICAN (3) has had the one career start, which was a brilliant victory at Hobart, winning by 25.2 metres. She was very green in the run, galloping and racing roughly. She is first-up in Victoria for Rebecca Bartley. She should perform well, but her manners are a query against more experienced mares. OZZIE TART (5) and QUEENHIGH FLUSH (2) are both speedy beginners who will likely look to map positively early. OZZIE TART (5) was a good fifth in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final two starts ago, but got it wrong with her manners at Mildura last start after jumping a shadow. That run is easy to forgive, and she will be looking to bounce back here. QUEENHIGH FLUSH (2) is in good form and gets the benefit of what should be a favourable race map here. FOUR EVER A STAR (1) is on the comeback after a few years on the sidelines. This is her fifth start back, and she’s getting better with each run. She has a good barrier here. SELECTIONS:MELICAN (3), OZZIE TART (5), QUEENHIGH FLUSH (2), FOUR EVER A STAR (1)

OVERVIEW: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) is a talented trotter who is still figuring out her race manners. She was a brilliant third behind superstar mares Gatesys Gem and Jilliby Dreamlover two starts back in the Vicbred Super Series heat. In the Group 1 Final, she hit the line well but was too far back. This is an easier race. ABBIE (7) is second-up here and should improve with fitness after her tough first-up run. She is a smart mare on her day, but she has an awkward barrier. VOLDAGHA (3) is another runner who is second-up here. Last start, he was beaten 14.6 metres behind the smart Muskee, and he should improve with fitness here. CHAMPAGNES (8) is a fast trotting mare who has had a brilliant, career-best 12 months of racing. This would be one of her toughest tests, but she is the only horse on the back row, so she has space to settle early. Also respecting MAJESTIC MONARCH (1) from the barrier. BACK: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2), ABBIE (7), VOLDAGHA (3), CHAMPAGNES (8).

OVERVIEW: MONEY TALKS (7) is only a two-time winner, but he’s consistent and rarely runs a bad race. He flashed home well from last to finish third last start and, with some luck, he can be flashing home again here. BETSY ANNE (4) has the gate speed to be tactical early and hopefully find a good position. She struggled a little last start at Charlton, but her runs prior were good and she looks ready to get back into the winner’s circle. CHARLIE WALKER (6) was a good winner when leading three starts back. He’s been performing well since and also has the gate speed to map well here. NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (5) is another consistent performer who rarely puts in a bad run. If he finds some luck, he’s a first-four chance here. SELECTIONS:MONEY TALKS (7), BETSY ANNE (4), CHARLIE WALKER (6), NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (5)

OVERVIEW: SILENT REVERIE (5) is a trotter who is racing well. She should have enough gate speed to find the front here and be hard to beat from there. She rarely races at Kilmore, but she has won at the track in one of her few attempts. AHUNDREDPLUS (6) is second-up here and should improve from her first-up seventh at Melton in a tougher race. The barrier is awkward, but the smaller field should help. CADENCE LANE (4) ran home well for a good third at Charlton last start. She is a nice horse at her best and looks close to returning to her best form. SABIHALIL (1) has the ace barrier and should get a good fence trip here. BACK: SILENT REVERIE (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SILENT REVERIE (5), AHUNDREDPLUS (6), CADENCE LANE (4), SABIHALIL (1) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: It is a very good start to the program with the return of the star local pacer MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4) taking on the smart Aaron Dunn trained pacers MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3) and HOT DEAL (6). MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4) won a heat of the Mildura Cup in April and boasts the record of nine wins from nineteen starts on the track including several victories in mile rates of better than 1.55.0. He won a trial at Mildura last week and should make his presence felt. HOT DEAL (6) also boasts an exceptional strike rate at Mildura (11 of 27) and he came out three horses wide from eighth at the bell when a big winner last outing. He is very versatile and should prove hard to beat again. MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3) trailed forward behind HOT DEAL (6) in the final lap and tried hard in the straight when a close second behind that pacer last time out. He is better drawn for this assignment and is worth thought again. PRIORITISE (5) was resuming since July when a creditable fourth behind Dhaulagiri at Mildura last outing. He should be fitter from that run and is capable of running into a place. BACK: - MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4), HOT DEAL (6), MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3), PRIORITISE (5)

OVERVIEW:ALWAYS ON SAFARI (1) began quickly from the outside of the front line to race without cover early, gained the one out and one back trail behind CALF PEN (3) mid-race and battled on fairly well for third at Mildura last outing. He is better drawn for this assignment and should be prominent throughout. LOUIEVILLE (8) is resuming since a seventh at Mildura in June but he will take beating if he is somewhere near his peak. He was competitive against stronger opposition when he was last in work. SHIRLEY NOT (2) worked home nicely to win two weeks ago then was making ground through the middle approaching the home turn but struck a sulky wheel and galloped at her latest unlucky ninth. She is worth another chance from her good draw. CALF PEN (3) circled around the field to race without cover and proved to be too strong at Mildura on Friday. That was his best run for a long time and he will go close again if he can repeat that performance. SELECTIONS: ALWAYS ON SAFARI (1), LOUIEVILLE (8), SHIRLEY NOT (2), CALF PEN (3)

OVERVIEW: KYORETSU (7) recorded successive victories at Mildura and Globe Derby prior to a third behind Neatntidy on Friday, where he began quickly from a wide draw and was able to angle in behind the leader on the first turn. He is awkwardly drawn but appears to be well placed against this opposition. UNITED (8) settled three back on the markers and couldn’t pick up over the latter stages when fifth in the same race won by Neatntidy last week. This is a drop back in class and he was an impressive winner over Lewielewis (won since) on August 07 so he is worth another chance. MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2) performed below expectations at Mildura on Friday, where he raced without cover early before gaining the one out and one back trail. He is better than that effort suggests and is capable of showing up from his good draw. RIO ROCK (1) should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a break and is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern so she could improve on her numerical form. BACK: KYORETSU (7) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: KYORETSU (7), UNITED (8), MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2), RIO ROCK (1)

OVERVIEW: ALMIGHTY RUSH (2) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of leading throughout. He attempted for an all of the way victory when second behind Pretty Mischievous over the 2190m at Mildura on September 11 and he will take catching over the sprint distance. LIKE A LIBRARIAN (10) was held up for a run at a vital stage and worked home okay for fifth at Mildura on Friday. She has been finding the line nicely in her recent appearances and appears to be suited against this line up. PHILS BOY (7) met a stronger field at Charlton when on debut and ran an even race for sixth in a mile of 1.58.2. He should have benefited from the experience and is worth thought under these conditions. CRUEL MISTRESS (9) was placed three times in succession in early August and hasn’t been far away at her recent performances. She is awkwardly drawn but is capable of running into a place. BACK: ALMIGHTY RUSH (2) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: ALMIGHTY RUSH (2), LIKE A LIBRARIAN (10), PHILS BOY (7), CRUEL MISTRESS (9)

OVERVIEW:FLEUR BELLA (2) led throughout in a victory over PUNTO CALIENTE (3) at Mildura on September 11 and is drawn to find the lead again. She didn’t run on over the latter stages at Mildura on Friday but she moves to the front line now and should give a bold showing. PUNTO CALIENTE (3) came from behind FLEUR BELLA (2) and beat that pacer to the line on Friday. He is racing consistently and deserves to break through for a win. THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (9) settled eighth on the outside, came out three horses wide from the 600m and finished off well for third behind Ned’s Beach at Mildura last outing. She is racing consistently and is worth a ticket each way. SNEAKY PHILTRA (4) was making ground out very wide on the track before locking wheels on the home turn when unplaced last week. She was racing really well during June/July and the move to the front line is a definite advantage so she might be able to return to some form. ROJENBYE (6), INDIANAS SON (7) and CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (8) are all capable of showing up in an open race. SELECTIONS: FLEUR BELLA (2), PUNTO CALIENTE (3), THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (9), SNEAKY PHILTRA (4)

OVERVIEW: HOOKLINEANDSINKER (2) ran a much sharper race second up on Friday when he attempted to lead throughout and finished second. He is drawn to lead again and should take catching over the sprint distance. BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (1) was driven aggressively early and battled on well for second behind Ned’s Beach at Mildura two starts ago. He endured a tough run on the outside of the leader last week and he should gain an economical trip from the pole position so he is not without a chance. ACCELERE (7) will need luck from the inside of the second line but he is racing in great form having been placed in all of his five starts since returning to Victoria. He led throughout at Mildura victory two starts ago then followed with a third in a handy mile rate of 1.58.6. BAZZAS LEGACY (8) competed in the Mildura Guineas on Friday and this race is a lot easier. He finished third in reasonable time at Mildura prior and looms as one of the leading chances. COME ON BILLEE (6) had no clear run and seemed to have something in reserve at his latest unlucky fourth. He is worth thought despite the wide draw. BACK: HOOKLINEANDSINKER (2) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: HOOKLINEANDSINKER (2), BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (1), ACCELERE (7), BAZZAS LEGACY (8)

ROCK HAMMER (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead which is a position he loves to race in. He sat without cover two starts ago applying pressure to the leader and was able to battle on well for a good third behind John Wayne. MY ULTIMATE CARTER (7) should get a good run through behind the likely leader in the race. He finished close up behind STORMTIDE (2) recently when getting a similar run to what he is likely to get in this race. BUDDY PERFECT (5) didn’t have a lot of luck last time out when drawing awkwardly inside the back row in a race there was some early trouble for a few of the runners in front of him. He should find this easier and can figure in the right run. STORMTIDE (2) has returned to form in recent outings and was particularly impressive last time out when running second to Sporty Zara after sitting without cover. He draws well in this race and should run well again. SELECTIONS: ROCK HAMMER (1), MY ULTIMATE CARTER (7), BUDDY PERFECT (5), STORMTIDE (2) SUGGESTED BET: ROCK HAMMER (1) to win.

PENNIE PACKER (2) was able to secure a good run on the pegs last time out and was running on well into fourth behind Denis The Punter. She has gate speed and may be able to press to the lead in the early stages which would likely see her hard to run down. SHEZ A PUNTER (4) got back in the run and was running on late into second behind TERRAGONG SWINGER (6) who had the ideal run behind the leader in that race. She is likely to get back again and will just be relying on a touch more tempo this time to bring her into the race. MISS FROUFROU (3) was able to secure a good run on the pegs last time out in a race taken out by Mahindi. She is likely to have derived benefit from te outing and should find this race a lot more suitable. WEONA SIR VIVOR (1) showed gate speed before handing over last start and battled on well for fourth there. He is likely to secure a similar run this time and should have derived good benefit from his latest outing. SELECTIONS: PENNIE PACKER (2), SHEZ A PUNTER (4), MISS FROUFROU (3), WEONA SIR VIVOR (1) SUGGESTED BET: PENNIE PACKER (2) to win.

PLANET DOWNS (1) was able to lead last time out when working hard early and was just run down late by Mighty Ideal who had secured a soft run off the speed in the run. He looks likely to be able to lead again and appears to be close to another win. SNIP OF BEAUTY (3) worked hard to find the lead before working away from the inside and just being run down late. She should get a good run again in this race close to the speed and should run well again. MISTER DELWIN (8) did plenty of work last time out and was well beaten as a result at this track. He should be able to score a more economical run early and can be driven to the tempo of the race. FEELIN FORASTAR (7) should get a good run through behind the leader in this race. She took on a slightly stronger race last time out and was racing off the pegs there. SELECTIONS: PLANET DOWNS (1), SNIP OF BEAUTY (3), MISTER DELWIN (8), FEELIN FORASTAR (7) SUGGESTED BET: PLANET DOWNS (1) to win.

MOONSHINE MILLY (6) was shuffled back early last time out and could only get into sixth late but wasn’t beaten far. He should get a good run off the speed again and if the race is run to suit he should be getting into it late. NOTIONS (5) got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late into second behind Delightfully Sweet. She is likely to get back again from a wide draw and should be running on late. MY ULTIMATE FELIX (1) got a long way back last time out before running on late in a race taken out by Sporty Zara. He may be crossed early having done a few things wrong at the start but should still be thereabouts. SWEET LAD JUJON (2) ran a better race last time out when getting back and running on nicely late into sixth making up good ground. He has good gate speed and may be able to work to the lead in the early stages. SELECTIONS: MOONSHINE MILLY (6), NOTIONS (5), MY ULTIMATE FELIX (1), SWEET LAD JUJON (2) SUGGESTED BET: MY ULTIMATE FELIX (1) each way.

JUKEBOX JET (9) had no luck last time out when getting a long way back before having to sustain a long run into it out wide on the track. He looks very well suited in this field and can be driven assertively. CONNIES SPIRIT (5) has excellent early speed and showed that last time out before handing over to TACKAS LAST DANCE (7) and just couldn’t quite run her down late. She has good gate speed and should find a prominent position in this race. TACKAS LAST DANCE (7) was able to find the lead last time out and kicked strongly late to just hold them off. She is likely to need luck in this race from inside the back row but is generally hard to hold out late when she does secure the right run in this type of grade. TRACER BULLET (6) was able to secure a good run last time out closing strongly to score there. He should get a good run off the speed and will just be relying on the race being run to suit. SELECTIONS: JUKEBOX JET (9), CONNIES SPIRIT (5), TACKAS LAST DANCE (7), TRACER BULLET (6) SUGGESTED BET: JUKEBOX JET (9) to win.

PLAYING FOR KEEPS (9) found the lead last time out before kicking clear and was just run down in the concluding stages by ROCKY OUTLOOK (6) who had the good run on her back. She is likely to be suited getting a soft run off the speed and should be running on well late. TAURUS BROMAC (4) took on a much stronger field last time out in a race taken out by Oyster Stride. He should secure a good run close to the speed and if the race is run to suit he should be running on well. ROCKY OUTLOOK (6) secured a good run last time out when nabbing the position behind the leader before running past to score. He is unlikely to secure such a good run from the wide draw this time but if the race is run to suit he should be running on well. BLACK GEMSTONE (8) was crossed early last time out before coming off the pegs and appearing to have her chance finishing fourth. She should secure a good run again in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: PLAYING FOR KEEPS (9), TAURUS BROMAC (4), ROCKY OUTLOOK (6), BLACK GEMSTONE (8) SUGGESTED BET: PLAYING FOR KEEPS (9) to win.

MCROCKIN (2) should have the speed to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. She sat leaders back last time out and wasn’t beaten far there by Twin Cities. AURELIE (6) made a break last time out before making up a lot of ground to finish close up in third. She is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing and with better manners looks a chance in this race. OUTRUNTHETIDE (4) was very impressive first up from a spell when running on strongly into second in an effort which appeared to suggest a maiden win was just around the corner. She couldn’t back that up second up but did take on a strong field. BOSTON BOUND (1) appeared to have her chance last time out when looming and finishing sixth. She may be an improver this time with a soft run on the pegs. SELECTIONS: MCROCKIN (2), AURELIE (6), OUTRUNTHETIDE (4), BOSTON BOUND (1) SUGGESTED BET: MCROCKIN (2) to win.

WHAT IS HIS NAME (9) ran a good race last time out when closing nicely late behind Go Minnie in a stronger race at Albion Park. He should appreciate the step back in company and looks hard to beat with the right run in the race. MATT DAN (8) is starting first up for the stable of Shawn Grimsey having trialled up quite well finishing second behind Big Reputation. He has the very slight draw advantage on his main rival in this race and can look to hold that early. AIRFORCE ONE (6) looked to struggle a touch in a recent trial prior to resuming before putting in a better run on return finishing fourth. He is likely to have derived benefit from those outings and can run well second up. CHEER ME ON (5) trialled up reasonably for a debutant in a very strong trial taken out by open class pacer Captain Shuffles. He draws awkwardly and may need a few things to go his way in the run. SELECTIONS: WHAT IS HIS NAME (9), MATT DAN (8), AIRFORCE ONE (6), CHEER ME ON (5) SUGGESTED BET: WHAT IS HIS NAME (9) to win.

AUNTY MEL (5) was able to work to the lead last time out before being run down late by Medellin who sat without cover in the run. She looks likely to be able to work to the lead again in this race and can give them something to catch out in front. WICKED BERRIES (7) took on a much stronger field last time out in a race taken out by Luvatinny. She should find this race a lot easier but she does draw quite awkwardly inside the back row. She looks hard to beat with luck in running. AZZIF (8) secured a good run last time out and was running on well late into third in a similar type of field. She draws to do no work early in this race and can be running on late again. SINKRATE (6) did plenty wrong last time out before getting back and running on late into fifth. He draws poorly in this race and may need a few things to go his way in the run. SELECTIONS: AUNTY MEL (5), WICKED BERRIES (7), AZZIF (8), SINKRATE (6) SUGGESTED BET: WICKED BERRIES (7) to win.
